ecuador.title: Flag of the Republic of Ecuador

colors.note: Top band at double width; represents the land's wealth and crops.
Middle band; represents the sky, sea, and rivers.
Bottom band; represents the blood of patriots.

desc:
- A horizontal tricolour of yellow (double width), blue, and red with the national coat of arms centred
- Descended from the flag of Gran Colombia designed by Francisco de Miranda in 1806
- The current design with the coat of arms was formalised on 26 September 1900
trivia:
- Ecuador, Colombia, and Venezuela share the yellow-blue-red colour scheme inherited from Gran Colombia
- The coat of arms features Mount Chimborazo, a steamship on the Guayas River, and a condor, distinguishing Ecuador's flag from its sister republics
- 26 September is celebrated as Flag Day in Ecuador
